Success Stories, Beauty, Ecology

Snake Mountain (East Nassau, Rensselaer County)

July 31, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

In partnership with Hudson Taconic Lands (HTL), we conserved 174 acres in the Village of East Nassau, known locally as Snake Mountain. HTL is working to turn the land into a public preserve so everyone can enjoy its twin-peaked hilltop, rocky cliffs, mixed upland forest, and dense hemlock groves that run down to Kinderhook Creek. (2026)
